meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Growth of bank credit and deposits on a year earlier, with and without the HDFC merger, and the credit-deposit, investment-deposit and cash-deposit ratios, every fortnight
meta.note: Derived from credit-scb (RBI DBIE report 689). Growth compares each reporting date with the reporting date closest to one year earlier (within 10 days): 364 days earlier on the alternate-Friday calendar; from December 2025, the nearest old-calendar Friday, as RBI does. Ex-merger growth uses RBI's adjusted levels while RBI published them (July 2023 to August 2025). Ratios are computed from the levels.
